The '''[[1959 in association football|1959]]–[[1960 in association football|60]] season''' was the 61st completed (62nd overall) season of [[The Football League]].

==Final league tables==

The tables below are reproduced here in the exact form that they can be found at [https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/1959-60.html The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation] website and in ''Rothmans Book of Football League Records 1888–89 to 1978–79'',<ref name="Rothmans">Ian Laschke: ''Rothmans Book of Football League Records 1888–89 to 1978–79''. Macdonald and Jane’s, London & Sydney, 1980.</ref> with home and away statistics separated.

Beginning with the season 1894–95, clubs finishing level on points were separated according to goal average (goals scored divided by goals conceded), or more properly put, goal ratio. In case one or more teams had the same goal difference, this system favoured those teams who had scored fewer goals. The goal average system was eventually scrapped beginning with the 1976–77 season.

Since the [[Football League Fourth Division|Fourth Division]] was established in the [[1958–59 Football League|1958–59 season]], the bottom four teams of that division have been required to apply for [[re-election (Football League)|re-election]].<ref name=" Rothmans"/>
